root_cause_analysis.formula_used: Intervals assume log-normal vol distribution with fixed sigma = 0.35
root_cause_analysis.distributional_mismatch: BTCUSDT intraday volatility exhibits severe kurtosis, volatility jumps, and clustering. A parametric log-normal model with constant sigma=0.35 fails to encompass market volatility bursts, leading to 15.0% excess tail breaches on 80% intervals and 16.2% excess breaches on 95% intervals.
root_cause_analysis.metric_definition_issue: The stored prediction intervals are hardcoded to the 1h horizon only in PredictionRecord. There are no separate 4h or 24h prediction intervals persisted in prospective records.
